reasoning_summary: The requested insertion is geometrically infeasible, so this plan performs only a noncontact approach and retreat, leaving the rack untouched. With the specified grasp and unchanged orientation, the rack at the requested insertion TCP would occupy x=[-1.642,-1.361], exceeding the cavity x=[-1.610,-1.390]. The insertion TCP is also 0.813 m from the base, outside the 0.75 m usable radius. Releasing there would additionally leave the rack unsupported above the chamber floor. No grasp or insertion is attempted; revised rack geometry, placement, and robot positioning are required.

Full-arm, gripper-envelope, inverse-kinematics, and swept-volume checks are required before executing even this noncontact staging plan; tool geometry and joint state were not supplied.
Interpolate translation steps to at most 0.020 m and validate the specified orientation-deviation limit of 0.25 rad.
